conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I tried applying for a car loan online, but the portal keeps saying ‘error.’ What’s wrong?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the trouble, sir. Can you specify which step the error occurs at?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s when I submit my income details. I don’t understand what I’m doing wrong.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It might be a system glitch. Try uploading your documents in PDF format, or I can process it manually.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Manual sounds better. Can you do it now?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Absolutely. Please email your documents to our loan desk, and I’ll start the application today.
